aiBaseline: Frozen scripts/lib/baseline-ai-v1.mjs from d46be8b; production AI may be newer.
method: Small controlled horizon/evaluation/opening/counterplay experiments. Full histories independently checked. Rotated/reflected duplicates identified explicitly; seed does not itself mean a new independent opening.
limitations: Reported search nodes have implementation-specific definitions and are not directly comparable across policies.
Reference policies use canonical color-relative tie breaks, so paired rotations are correlated negative controls, not independent samples.
Guarded policy combines an exact immediate-loss filter with one-ply ranking; its strength is not a human-learning result.
Openings are randomized legal prefixes and may already favor one side.
Depth/budget totals and exact source hashes are logged.
